roleTitle: Project Manager, Insurance Policy Administration Migration
jobDescription: Life and pensions policies are leaving the insurer's legacy administration system for the new platform one product tranche at a time, and every tranche has to reconcile to the penny before it goes live. The Project Manager who runs a tranche owns its migration plan and reconciliation schedule, writes the weekly steering report, keeps the vendor and policy operations dependencies moving through the dependency log, and closes the tranche with the reconciliation evidence. The steering committee, not the project manager, decides go-live. Explaining reconciliation breaks to that committee under questioning is a weekly duty. Reports to the head of policy migration; works with the platform vendor, policy operations and the steering committee.
requirements: Owns a tranche's migration plan and reconciliation schedule under the insurer's delivery framework.
Prepares the weekly steering report and explains reconciliation breaks to the steering committee under questioning.
Keeps vendor and policy operations dependencies moving through the framework's dependency log.
Prepares go-live readiness, with the decision staying with the steering committee, and records own responsibility boundaries.
Documents project boundaries and reconciliation evidence at closure.

evidence.text: Project manager on a life and pensions insurer's policy administration migration for three years, owning the migration plans and reconciliation schedules of three product tranches under the insurer's delivery framework.

Prepared the weekly steering report for each tranche and presented the reconciliation breaks to the steering committee; the committee minutes record the questions raised on each break and the explanations accepted across the thirty-one weekly sessions I presented.
Kept the platform vendor and policy operations dependencies moving through the framework's dependency log, taking three vendor slips to the committee for escalation.

Prepared the go-live readiness review for each tranche; the go-live decision was the steering committee's, recorded on the review together with which checks were mine and which were policy operations'.
Wrote the closure report for each tranche with the project boundary statement and the reconciliation evidence accepted by the finance controller.

Work sample: one migration plan with its reconciliation schedule, the committee minutes for two sessions, one readiness review with the committee's decision and one closure report, with the migration repository references as a verification trail.

Interviewer 2 note: given the sample reconciliation break, the candidate separated the policies with a timing difference from the two with a data error, gave the count and the amount for each group, named who owned each fix and by when, and answered the follow-up on the data error with the specific field involved.

Reference call with the former head of policy migration: confirmed the candidate ran the three tranches and presented to the committee in the period, that go-live decisions stayed with the committee, and confirmed the dates.
